differences: Text A makes the blight 1 the optional first step and creates the Treasure only if the player blights; Text B creates the Treasure first (conditioned on controlling a creature) and then puts the -1/-1 counter afterward, so the order of the steps differs.

Text B adds an explicit condition ("If you control a creature") for the Treasure that Text A does not state as a separate condition, and it uses "precombat main phase" where Text A says "first main phase".
